> "Is the problem the fact that you have now a new state in the history even if you didn't change anything yet?" - Yes, given that we are using searchFunction, our category and other catalog views can't be appending parameters each time any of those pages are viewed only.

@austin-roberts, I'm not sure I get the issue. With the search function you add some parameters. Do you want them displayed in the URL? Or hidden?
